name: 80130 · Hghlnds Ranch, CO
findings: ZIP 80130 (Hghlnds Ranch) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80130 (Hghlnds Ranch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80130 (Hghlnds Ranch) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
